namesZh: 中国医学科学院整形外科医院 (八大处)

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等整形外科专科医院，隶属中国医学科学院北京协和医学院。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A specialist plastic surgery hospital, affiliated with CAMS and Peking Union Medical College.

namesZh: 海南医学院第一附属医院 整形美容外科
海南医科大学第一附属医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等综合医院；2024年更名为海南医科大学第一附属医院。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A general hospital; renamed the First Affiliated Hospital of Hainan Medical University in 2024.

namesZh: 海南医科大学第二附属医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等综合医院，设主院区、东湖分院和乌石分院。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A general hospital, with main, Donghu and Wushi campuses.

namesZh: 浙江省立同德医院

facts.valueZh: 浙江省卫生健康委直属三级甲等中西医结合医院。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A integrated Chinese and Western medicine hospital under the Zhejiang Health Commission.

namesZh: 广州市番禺区中心医院

facts.valueZh: 区属公立三级甲等综合医院；现名广州医科大学附属番禺中心医院。
facts.valueEn: Public Grade III Class A general hospital; now Guangzhou Medical University Affiliated Panyu Central Hospital.

namesZh: 广州市花都区人民医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等综合性医院；2026年加挂“暨南大学附属广州医院”牌子。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A general hospital; also named Jinan University Affiliated Guangzhou Hospital since 2026.

namesZh: 海南省眼科医院

facts.valueZh: 海南省卫生健康委直属公立三级甲等眼科专科医院。
facts.valueEn: Public Grade III Class A specialist eye hospital under the Hainan Health Commission.

namesZh: 首都医科大学附属北京口腔医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等口腔专科医院。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A specialist stomatology hospital.

namesZh: 杭州整形医院

facts.valueZh: 三级整形专科医院；主管集团公开介绍未注明甲等，未将5A行业评价等同于三甲。
facts.valueEn: Grade III specialist plastic surgery hospital. The group profile does not specify Class A; its industry 5A rating is a separate designation.

namesZh: 上海市浦东新区公利医院

facts.valueZh: 浦东新区卫生健康委所属公立三级甲等综合性医院。
facts.valueEn: Public Grade III Class A general hospital under the Pudong Health Commission.

namesZh: 杭州师范大学附属医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等综合医院；国家住院医师规范化培训基地。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A general hospital and a national standardized residency training base.

namesZh: 三亚中心医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等综合医院，又称海南省第三人民医院。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A general hospital, also known as Hainan Third People’s Hospital.

namesZh: 三亚市人民医院

facts.valueZh: 市属三级甲等综合医院。
facts.valueEn: Municipal Grade III Class A general hospital.

namesZh: 三亚市中医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等中医医院。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A traditional Chinese medicine hospital.

namesZh: 广东省第二人民医院 整形美容科

facts.valueZh: 广东省卫生健康委直属医院，又称广东省应急医院。
facts.valueEn: Hospital under the Guangdong Health Commission, also known as Guangdong Provincial Emergency Hospital.

namesZh: 万宁市人民医院

facts.valueZh: 三级综合医院；所引用官网页面未注明甲等。
facts.valueEn: Grade III general hospital; the cited official page does not specify Class A.

namesZh: 浙江省眼科医院杭州院区

facts.valueZh: 温州医科大学附属眼视光医院（浙江省眼科医院）的杭州院区；医院为三级甲等眼科专科医院。
facts.valueEn: Hangzhou campus of the Eye Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University / Zhejiang Eye Hospital, a Grade III Class A specialist eye hospital.

namesZh: 树兰（杭州）医院

facts.valueZh: 社会办三级甲等综合医院。
facts.valueEn: Privately operated Grade III Class A general hospital.

namesZh: 琼海市人民医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等综合医院；海南省东部区域医疗中心。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A general hospital and Hainan eastern regional medical centre.

namesZh: 海南省妇女儿童医学中心

facts.valueZh: 海南省卫生健康委直属的省级非营利性妇女儿童医疗保健机构，实行“一中心三院”布局。
facts.valueEn: Provincial non-profit women’s and children’s healthcare institution under the Hainan Health Commission, operating across three hospital campuses.

namesZh: 海南省中医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等中医医院，现以广东省中医院海南医院等名称对外发布资料。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A traditional Chinese medicine hospital, now publishing under the name Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Chinese Medicine Hainan Hospital.

namesZh: 海口市中医医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等综合性中医医院；广州中医药大学附属医院和海南医学院教学医院。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A traditional Chinese medicine hospital, affiliated with Guangzhou University of Chinese Medicine and a teaching hospital of Hainan Medical University.

namesZh: 儋州市人民医院

facts.valueZh: 公立三级甲等综合性医院。
facts.valueEn: Public Grade III Class A general hospital.

facts.valueZh: 医院官网设有医疗机构执业许可证公示页，可查看原件。
facts.valueEn: The hospital publishes its medical institution licence on its official website; view the source document.

namesZh: 上海九院 整形外科
上海交通大学医学院附属第九人民医院

facts.valueZh: 三级甲等综合性教学医院；整复外科属于该医院科室，不能将科室视为独立持证机构。
facts.valueEn: Grade III Class A general teaching hospital. Plastic and reconstructive surgery is a department of the hospital, rather than a separately registered institution.

namesZh: 北京加减美医疗美容医院
北京加减美医疗美容门诊部

facts.valueZh: 官网机构全称为北京加减美医疗美容门诊部，位于北京市西城区鸭子桥路6号8幢；未据此认定医院等级或具体手术准入。
facts.valueEn: The official site identifies Beijing Jiajianmei Medical Aesthetic Outpatient Clinic at Building 8, 6 Yaziqiao Road, Xicheng District. No hospital grade or procedure-specific authorization is inferred.

namesZh: RODEO柔缇欧（上海旗舰店）

facts.valueZh: 官网公布的上海旗舰店为预约制医美服务机构；当前门店执业登记全称、执业范围和许可证有效期需按具体注册机构核实。
facts.valueEn: The official site describes an appointment-based Shanghai aesthetic clinic. The branch’s registered legal name, licensed scope and licence validity must be checked against its specific registration.

namesZh: 博鳌乐城国际医疗旅游先行区

facts.valueZh: 国际医疗旅游园区，并非单一医院；园区内各医疗机构分别持证，不能以园区政策替代机构资质。
facts.valueEn: An international medical tourism zone, rather than a single hospital. Each healthcare provider requires its own institutional registration.
